title: Mini Cactus
description: A tiny amigurumi cactus in a small pot. Quick, cute, and no watering required.
expectationText: A cheerful desk companion that teaches increasing for shaping and decreasing for closing, all in a compact project you can finish in under an hour.

steps.title: Make the cactus body
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring in green. The body is worked in continuous rounds without joining.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 6 single crochet into the magic ring.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Increase in each stitch around for 12 stitches.

steps.title: Round 3
steps.instruction: Work 1 single crochet, then increase in the next stitch around for 18 stitches.

steps.title: Rounds 4 to 9
steps.instruction: Single crochet around without increasing to build height.

steps.title: Stuff and close
steps.instruction: Stuff the cactus firmly. Then work decreases by crocheting 2 stitches together around until closed. Fasten off and weave in.

steps.title: Make the pot
steps.instruction: Switch to brown yarn. Start with a magic ring, work 6 single crochet, then increase to 12, then to 18. Work 4 rounds even. Do not close fully.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.instruction: Place the cactus inside the pot. Sew the bottom of the cactus to the inside of the pot. Optionally embroider small yellow flowers on top.
